question: Across the fixed 207-gene confirmatory panel, is observed format-bundle score lability (6 measured Broad models) associated with donor-averaged normalized displacement from the fixed Broad 2D consensus dependency ordering in the donor-disjoint Sanger organoid cohort (148 models / 144 donors), beyond ranked absolute baseline dependency strength?

estimand.parameter: partial Spearman rho = Pearson correlation of rank residuals of D_g and L_g after OLS on ranks of base_strength_g (with intercept); src/estimators.py partial_spearman / src/donor_kernel.py rank_correlations
estimand.population_conditioning: Conditional on the 207 fixed genes, the 6 measured Broad format-contrast models (fixed measured covariates; Broad donors unresolved) and the processed Sanger Table 6 measurements; inference targets the Sanger donor population represented by 144 donors.
estimand.L_g: mean_abs_delta: equal-weight mean over 6 models (ACH-000108, ACH-000178, ACH-001418, ACH-002958, ACH-003040, ACH-003052) of within-model mean |Chronos_Dome - Chronos_Plastic| over that model's matched medium pairs (Layer A, figshare 29472362 v1)
estimand.reference_ordering: signed AdherentMean (Broad adherent 2D mean Chronos, organoids_vs_2d_gene_dependency_tests_full.csv) ranked within the 207 genes, average ties
estimand.D_g: for each model: within-207 average ranks of Sanger Table 6 LFC (selected library); |rank - reference rank|/(G-1); models averaged within donor first (integer-exact), donors equally weighted
estimand.measurement_systems: Chronos and Sanger LFC compared only through within-assay ranks; never subtracted

cohort.library_rule: minLib if available else v1_1 (133 minLib incl. 13 dual, 15 v1_1-only)
cohort.presence_audit: ID-only registry (lock_s/presence.json): all 148 samples present; 0 missing of 207 genes in primary library; 0 missing in alternate library for 13 dual models; 0 duplicates; TMOD1 present in all 148 primary libraries
cohort.nonfinite_rule: A model with any nonfinite/missing selected-library cell among the analysis genes is excluded from that analysis (listed); if exclusions exceed 5% of 148 models (i.e. >7) the analysis is INCONCLUSIVE. Donors with remaining models are retained.
cohort.exclusion_reporting: Every analysis (primary, S1-S4) reports n_models_analyzed, n_donors_analyzed and the full model_exclusions list.

primary_decision.interval: donor-cluster percentile bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20261028, numpy default_rng integers draws over unique donors; all nested models carried together; L_g and reference treated as fixed
primary_decision.invalid_rules: point degenerate/nonfinite -> INCONCLUSIVE; >250/5000 failed replicates, nonfinite endpoints or width<=0 -> INCONCLUSIVE; no substitute interval after failure
primary_decision.rule: lo > 0.20 -> SIGNAL; hi < -0.20 -> NEGATIVE; -0.20 < lo and hi < 0.20 -> BOUND; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (src/confirmatory_estimand.py decision)
primary_decision.single_execution: Only via src/run_external_eval.py (run_bounded, phase6_7, job external_eval_lock2_v1, cpu_heavy, 2 GiB, 600 s); src/cli.py evaluate-external dispatches to it; external_eval.main refuses without exactly one outstanding bounded reservation for this job. Atomic O_EXCL fsynced start record precedes the exposure record and decoding; results committed with fsync + no-overwrite hard links. Result present -> refuse; start record without result -> refuse pending documented adjudication (no silent rerun). No alternative primary after seeing results.
primary_decision.failure_behavior: Degenerate/invalid extraction or kernel results are recorded as structured INCONCLUSIVE outcomes (never crash); stability failures are recorded per item and never block persistence.

secondary_family.control: Holm FWER 0.05 over exactly 4 hypotheses H0: rho = 0. Two-sided bootstrap p over ALL B=5000 replicates from the same frozen donor draws: p = min(1, 2*min((#{v<=0}+F+1)/(B+1), (#{v>=0}+F+1)/(B+1))), F = failed (nonfinite) replicates counted against rejection in both tails. An analysis with invalid point or interval keeps its family slot with p=None (treated as 1 in Holm), holm_adjusted_p=None and never rejects.

preregistered_predictions.conjecture: Positive association (more format-labile genes are more displaced in organoids beyond baseline strength).
preregistered_predictions.lead_expectation: Small positive point estimate; most likely decision BOUND or INCONCLUSIVE. Development analog using Broad aggregate T_g gave partial 0.055 (model-bootstrap stability [-0.086, 0.162]); that analog uses a different outcome and does not predict D_g quantitatively.

decision_claim_map.SIGNAL: Within the fixed 207-gene panel and conditional on 6 measured Broad models, observed format lability is positively associated with donor-averaged displacement in the Sanger organoid cohort beyond baseline strength, with |partial rho| > 0.20 supported by the donor 95% interval. Association only; no causal or per-gene vulnerability claim; novelty requires the final C1 refresh.
decision_claim_map.NEGATIVE: Evidence against the positive conjecture: a substantial negative conditional association (partial rho < -0.20). Association only.
decision_claim_map.BOUND: Informative bound: the conditional panel-wide association magnitude is below 0.20 (donor 95% interval within (-0.20, 0.20)); observed format lability does not materially track organoid displacement beyond baseline strength in this panel. Not equivalence for other genes, populations or latent biological sensitivity.
decision_claim_map.INCONCLUSIVE: No supported claim; interval includes material association or analysis invalid. Not evidence of absence.

gate_mapping.C6_candidate: SIGNAL, NEGATIVE or BOUND may be evaluated as a candidate explanatory finding/refutation/bound; INCONCLUSIVE cannot.
